Speaking at a memorial ceremony, Katz clarified that Israel would not retreat from its line in Gaza until Hamas is removed and the region is demilitarized. He also addressed the campaign against Iran, stating they eliminated Khamenei and the nuclear threat, emphasizing that the work is not done and they will strike a third time if necessary.

headlines.snippet: Natanel Sharoni, who was murdered in a shooting attack near Neve Tzuf, was laid to rest in the cemetery in Ali Zahav. His 16-year-old son, Yoav, who was with him during the attack, bid him farewell, saying, 'Thank you for giving me life.' His wife, Merav, described him as the most involved father in the world, and his sister, Ruti, remembered him as a pleasant, wise, and humble person.
headlines.title_he: נתנאל שקרון ז"ל שנרצח בפיגוע סמוך לנווה צוף הובא למנוחות

headlines.title: נתנאל שקרון הוא הנרצח בפיגוע במעיין בבנימין; המחבל נלכד בבית חולים ברמאללה
headlines.snippet: Natanel Sharoni is the victim of a shooting attack near a spring in Benjamin; the attacker was apprehended at a hospital in Ramallah. A terrorist opened fire on people at a spring near Neve Tzuf, abandoned his vehicle, and fled on foot. Natanel Sharoni, a father of six from Ali Zahav, who had come to immerse himself before Yom Kippur, was evacuated in critical condition and pronounced dead at Beilinson Hospital. Following an extensive manhunt, Duvdevan unit soldiers arrested the terrorist inside a Ramallah hospital after he was wounded by IDF tracker fire during the pursuit. About an hour later, a second terrorist who attempted a ramming attack in northern Samaria was killed.
